description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called TopicTile, which is a customizable, interactive tile used in a UI to display a topic with an emoji/icon at the top-left and a label at the bottom-left. It includes visual effects like ripple on tap, slight lift animation, and shadow effects.

classes.name: TopicTile
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a colorful, interactive tile featuring an emoji/icon and a label with animation and accessibility features.

classes.name: _TopicTileState
classes.description: State class managing the pressed state and building the animated UI for TopicTile.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the TopicTile widget.

methods.name: _setPressed
methods.description: Updates the pressed state to trigger lift animation and shadow.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including Semantics, AnimatedContainer, Material, InkWell, and positioning of emoji and label.
